en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a street scene in an old European city. The focus is a multi‑story historic building with a gabled roof and a small bay-window turret. German text on the facade identifies it as an inn or guesthouse called "Gasthaus zur Pastete" with additional signs such as "Gastwirtschaft zur Pastete" and "Speisezimmer 1. Stock". A narrow, slightly sloping street with other attached houses runs to the right. At the bottom margin, printed caption text reads: "GRAZ, Gasthaus 'zur Pastete' Sporgasse."
